faq.question: Do I need design experience before joining?
faq.answer: No. The track starts with UX basics and builds toward product-level execution.

faq.question: Will I build portfolio projects inside the course?
faq.answer: Yes. Modules are designed to create artifacts you can refine into case studies.

faq.question: Which tools are used in this program?
faq.answer: The workflow focuses on Figma, wireframing, prototyping, and design system practice.

tasks.title: UX Flow Mapping
tasks.assignment: Map out the UX flow for a SaaS dashboard.
tasks.ai_review: The AI connects to the Figma API to check if the student used proper layer naming conventions, auto-layout protocols, and correct frame sizing.

tasks.title: Design Tokens System
tasks.submission: A JSON file of Design Tokens (or exported CSS variables).
tasks.assignment: Create a standardized color and typography system.
tasks.ai_review: The AI verifies WCAG color contrast ratios, consistent padding variables such as base-8 spacing, and responsive font sizing.

tasks.title: State-Based Button Design
tasks.assignment: Design a primary button with Default, Hover, Active, and Disabled states.
tasks.ai_review: The AI scans for the presence of specific CSS pseudo-classes like :hover and :disabled, plus smooth transition logic.

tasks.title: Mobile UI to Code
tasks.assignment: Translate a mobile UI screen into structured HTML/Tailwind CSS.
tasks.ai_review: The AI checks for mobile-first media queries and semantic HTML tags such as nav, main, and footer.

tasks.title: 3-Page SaaS Checkout Flow
tasks.submission: Interactive prototype link plus UX reasoning document.
tasks.assignment: Design a complete, 3-page SaaS checkout flow and submit the interactive prototype link along with a UX reasoning document.
tasks.ai_review: The AI reads the reasoning document, ensuring the student justifies design choices using terms like Friction Reduction and Conversion Rate Optimization while cross-referencing required Figma components.
